record.title: Prepare fixed standalone derived-library bandwidth observation
record.intent: Verify the actual loaded D-capability library and two cached bandwidth words without target execution.
requirements: Derive a fixed read-only standalone ELF observer from the established reader discipline, pinned only to the accepted derived Auklet hash and two4-byte raw/effective bandwidth globals; preserve stock profiles unchanged.
Preserve process boot/starttime, exact ELF geometry/file metadata and map epochs, repeated raw samples and bounded failures; no attachment, target calls, target writes or arbitrary address inputs.
Test positive fixed mapped fixture and wrong-pin/epoch/mapping controls in the pinned isolated guest; independently verify source/native pins and sample bounds.
acceptance: The derived two-word observer is ready for a separate physical deployment verification.
